title: Premium Billing Accounts — Vision-Line Credits Already Booked for an Ended Vision Plan Unit
content:
Credits already booked on the vision line for a vision plan unit that ended by voluntary termination are deducted from that unit's termination credit on Premium Billing Accounts. The deduction is taken from the product of the amount per month and the months counted, before anything is added, and the remainder never falls below 0.00.

**What is deducted**
- When termination credits on the vision line were booked since the unit's termination month, their total is deducted.
- When none was, but plan-change difference credits on the vision line were booked since then, their total is deducted.
- Otherwise nothing is deducted.

**Booked since the termination month.** A credit counts as booked since the unit's termination month when the whole calendar months from its booking date to the credit date are no more than the whole calendar months from the unit's termination date to the credit date. Whole calendar months are counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it).

**Input – judgement – result (hypothetical; termination 31 March, credit date 10 May, so the reference count is 1 whole month).**
| Vision-line credits on the ledger | Counts as since the termination month? | Deducted |
|---|---|---|
| termination credit 13.25 booked 20 April | 20 April to 10 May: 0 months — yes | 13.25 |
| no termination credit; plan-change difference credit 4.10 booked 2 May | 0 months — yes | 4.10 |
| termination credit 13.25 booked 20 April and plan-change difference credit 4.10 booked 2 May | yes, both | 13.25 (termination credits take precedence) |
| termination credit 9.00 booked 5 February | 5 February to 10 May: 3 months — no | nothing |
